Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Slayn & Korpil Facilities]]: part of the body copy of a Buick Regal advertisement ("You've earned it."), with the lines "But one thing's for sure. Regal is a Buick. And that means quality." outlined. Cropped from the newspaper page scan and enlarged.

Source: ''Call and Post'' (Columbus, Ohio), 17 April 1976, page 14A, scan at the [https://archive.org/details/columbuscallpost63lync_14 Internet Archive] (item columbuscallpost63lync_14, leaf 13).

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a small crop of one advertisement, shown only to identify the real advertising line that the card's lore resembles, beside the card on [[Jokes]]. It cannot replace the original or harm its market.
